mechanics.name: Streetwise
mechanics.currentEffect: Items with Charges retrieved from Chests permanently receive 60/70/80% more Charges. The first time your currently equipped Item is depleted, the Killer's Aura is revealed to you for 8 seconds.
activation: The increased charges apply to an Item with Charges retrieved from a Chest.
The Aura reveal triggers the first time your currently equipped Item is depleted.
Ends/deactivates when: The Killer Aura reveal ends after 8 seconds and does not repeat after its first trigger.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (9.1.0): Reworked the perk to give chest-found charged items 60/70/80% more Charges and reveal the Killer Aura for 8 seconds the first time the equipped Item is depleted.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Chest-found charged items hold more charges, and the first time your equipped item runs out you briefly see the Killer.
mechanics.oncePerTrialOrOtherLimits: The Killer Aura reveal triggers only the first time your currently equipped Item is depleted.
specialInteractions: The bonus charges apply only to charge-using Items retrieved from Chests.

editorial.summary: Items retrieved from chests gain up to 80% more charges, and the first time your held Item is depleted you see the Killer's Aura for 8 seconds.
useCases: Turn a good chest find into a much deeper pool of Toolbox, Med-Kit, or Flashlight charges.
Combine with chest-search perks to increase the chance the bonus lands on a useful Item.
Use the depletion Aura read to understand Killer location after consuming the Item.
counters: The charge bonus only affects Items retrieved from chests.
Random chest loot may not be worth amplifying.
Bringing a premium Item from the lobby receives no charge bonus.
pros: 80% extra charges is a large multiplier.
Works across multiple charged Item types.
cons: Reworked version no longer supports carried lobby Items the old way.
Requires an Item to be depleted for the information payoff.
analysis: Streetwise ranks here because the current perk is fundamentally different from the old nearby-item-efficiency aura. It now rewards chest loot specifically, adding up to 80% more charges to charged Items found during the Trial.

That multiplier is substantial when the chest produces a useful Toolbox or Med-Kit. The problem is that the perk does not control what the chest contains, so a large bonus on an Item you did not need is still poor value.
The eight-second Killer Aura read on first depletion adds a little independent utility and can help decide what to do immediately after consuming the resource.

Streetwise therefore belongs in chest-focused builds rather than normal Item builds. Plunderer's Instinct and Appraisal can improve the loot pipeline, but the perk is too dependent on random map resources for a higher rank.
editorial.verdict: A huge charge multiplier attached to random chest loot. Modern Streetwise can make a great find much better, but it cannot guarantee the find is great.
